title: Design System: Things To Do With Kids

display.purpose: Hero and city-page headlines. Fraunces, tight tracking, short lines.

title.purpose: Card, row, and module titles. Plus Jakarta Sans semibold.

label.purpose: Metadata, chips, breadcrumbs, and controls. Plus Jakarta Sans medium.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Default card and control rest state.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover lift and featured collections only.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and small layout shifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dark filled action. Verb-led. One per section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1C1915; color: #F6F1EA; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 22px; min-height: 44px; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2F6B57; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6D8A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper fill with ink keyline for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #F6F1EA; color: #1C1915; border: 1px solid #1C1915; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 22px; min-height: 44px; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #E7DCC7; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6D8A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Large rounded location/activity search with visible label.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8A8178; } .ds-search-label { } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid #D9D0C5; border-radius: 18px; background: #F6F1EA; color: #1C1915; font: 500 1rem/1.4 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6D8A; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #3E6D8A; }

components.name: Collection Card
components.description: One title, one supporting line, one destination. Whole-card internal link.
components.html: Gold CoastThis weekendWhat’s on for kids right now
components.css: .ds-card-collection { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; background: #E7DCC7; color: #1C1915; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 25, 21, 0.06); min-height: 10rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-collection strong { font: 600 1.25rem/1.2 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-kicker { font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8A8178; } .ds-card-collection:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(28, 25, 21, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-collection:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6D8A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Interactive filter. Not a read-only badge.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #D9D0C5; border-radius: 999px; background: #F6F1EA; color: #1C1915; font: 500 0.875rem/1 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #1C1915; color: #F6F1EA; border-color: #1C1915; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6D8A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Read-only fact. Do not style identically to filter chips.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(47, 107, 87, 0.12); color: #1C1915; font: 500 0.8125rem/1 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: Illustrated Australian field guide with the confidence of a polished search product
narrative.overview: Things To Do With Kids should feel like a warm, modern, mobile-first family discovery guide: useful before decorative, adventurous without cliché, playful without looking childish. Sketch informs spacing, type, rounded structure, and restraint — not its brand, SaaS grids, or monochrome product-demo look.

rules.name: Pastel fields, dark ink
rules.body: Accent colours are background fields and illustration colours, not interchangeable text colours. Dark ink on pastel; never white text on pastels by default.

rules.name: One accent per section
rules.body: Use one dominant accent per section and no more than three visible accent families in a viewport.

rules.name: Sentence case
rules.body: Use sentence case. Avoid title case across navigation and headings. Uppercase only for very short date, category, or eyebrow labels.

rules.name: No equal-card grids
rules.body: Do not default to three equal cards. Mix a strong lead item with smaller supporting paths, or use a deliberate list.

dos: Do lead with city context, then the outing promise, then practical facts.
Do write like a knowledgeable local parent in Australian English.
Do keep events as collections on the national homepage, never individual event cards.
Do make external actions explicit and open them in a new tab.
donts: Don't ship a homepage dominated by individual listings.
Don't use childish rainbow styling, novelty fonts, or cartoon UI chrome.
Don't wrap an entire place row in an external link.
Don't fabricate practical details, testimonials, or stale event dates.
